# iaracreates

> The website of Iara Lucena: a content designer and UX writer in the Netherlands, and maker of one-of-a-kind handmade bags in Blaricum. Available in English, Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br/) and Dutch (/nl/).

## About Iara Lucena

- Content designer and UX writer with 10+ years of experience, at companies including Booking.com, Miro and Nebius.
- Turns ideas, goals and requirements into clear words that guide users in a human, relevant way.
- Based in the Netherlands for 17+ years. Works in Portuguese (native), English and Dutch.
- Contact: iaracreates.info@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/iara-lucena-210485104 · Instagram: @iaracreates

## Content design

- [Content design overview](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/): role, approach and scope of work
- [Case studies](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/): eight projects across UX/UI, user journeys and content strategy
  - [Content Design AI Buddy](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/content-design-ai-buddy/): A hackathon proof of concept that became the design team’s daily content companion.
  - [Order tracking journey](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/order-tracking-journey/): End-to-end collaboration from discovery research to delivery.
  - [Cancellation flow](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/cancellation-flow/): Retention through transparency — a respectful, low-friction path.
  - [Wallet & rewards at Booking.com](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/booking-wallet-rewards/): Making a complex loyalty product feel easy to understand and trustworthy.
  - [Agile planning tool beta launch](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/agile-planning-tool-launch/): Leading UX writing for a brand-new product launch.
  - [Website replatforming at Bugaboo](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/bugaboo-website-replatforming/): Six months, one writer, an entire digital ecosystem.
  - [Scaled content design library](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/content-design-library/): A self-service library so product teams can write great UI copy on their own.
  - [Translations workflow automation](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/projects/translations-workflow-automation/): Bridging engineering and localization over an 8-month project.
- [Continuous learning](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/continuous-learning/): certificates on designing with and for AI (IDEO U, Interaction Design Foundation, Google Cloud, Maven)
- [Public speaking](https://iaracreates.com/content-design/public-speaking/): talks, lectures and podcasts, including Figma Config 2022

## Handmade

- One-of-a-kind handmade bags by Iara Lucena (For the Love of Zelda, a collection by iaracreates). This part of the site opens in January 2027.
